page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head "CO." centred at the top and page number 136 at the top left. No margin notes. Catchword absent; the last word "stos" sits at the right below the final line as a catchword-like continuation of "distra-".

main_text.p: improbitatem, Cic. Perdomare provinciam, Liv. Resteda- re morbos, Plin. Edomare, Incidere alicujus nervos, Cic. Constringere alicujus superbiam, Tit. Detonsus est, Claud. Habenas injicere.

Competit hoc illi] Spectat aliquid ad bene vivendum. Pertinet aliquid ad me, tc, &c. Pertinet eo, Cic. Facit ad bonos mores, Ovid. Habet in hac re (vel hic) partes, Ter. Attinet. Hoc te non attingit, Cic.

Compilare] Expilare fanum, Cic. Effringere thesaurum, Plin. Iun. Refringere cellas, Plaut. Perfringere domum alicujus, Tacit. Spoliare fanum, despoliare templum. Diripere domum. Depeculari aliquem, Cic. Expugnare domum, Horat.

Compingere] Conglutinare, Plin. Glutinatur vulnus, Id. Coagmentare, Cic. Conjungere cerâ calamos, Virg. Committere aliquid alicui, Cæs. Solidare fracta, Plin. Iun. Concorporare aliquid. Agglutinare. Ferruminare, Plin. Coadunare. Consolidare, Ulp.
Compitum] Divortium viarum, Tacit. Quadrivium, Serv. Gruma, Non.
Complanare] Redigere ad æqualitatem, planum. Vid. Æquare. Coæquare. Deplanare.
Complementum] Supplementum legionum, Cic. Cæs. Explementum ventris, Sen.
Complere] Complere ad summum, Col. Supplere, Cat. Explere, Cic. Succenturiare. Integrare, Fest. vid. Implere.
Completus] Expletus omnibus suis partibus & numeris, Cic. Terminata oratio, Id. vid. Plenus.
Complodere] Manus collidere, Quint. Infonare flagello, Virg. vid. Collidere.
Componere] Construere. Contexere. Struere verba, Cic.
Componere litigantes] Constituere concordiam. Ad concordiam rem adducere. In pristinam concordiam distractos

page.notes: Catchword "ctos" is a fragment of "distractos" printed at the right; reading uncertain. Running head "CO." is the page's head word. Ending word "distra-" is hyphenated at the line end.
